```plato

    // The diamond cubic cell: four interior nodes at the quarter points, each
    // bonded tetrahedrally to one corner and three face centers. Coordination 4
    // everywhere. Four of the eight corners carry no strut inside this cell;
    // they are listed because the tiling needs a node on every cube corner, and
    // once tiled all eight are the same welded node.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diamond_cubic)
    DiamondCubic(_: LatticeUnitCell): LatticeUnitCell
        => LatticeUnitCell(
            LatticeUnitCell.CubeCorners
                .Concatenate(LatticeUnitCell.CubeFaceCenters)
                .Concatenate([
                    Point3D(0.25, 0.25, 0.25), Point3D(0.75, 0.75, 0.25),
                    Point3D(0.75, 0.25, 0.75), Point3D(0.25, 0.75, 0.75)
                ]),
            [
                Strut(14, 0), Strut(14, 8), Strut(14, 10), Strut(14, 12),
                Strut(15, 2), Strut(15, 8), Strut(15, 11), Strut(15, 13),
                Strut(16, 5), Strut(16, 9), Strut(16, 10), Strut(16, 13),
                Strut(17, 7), Strut(17, 9), Strut(17, 11), Strut(17, 12)
            ]);
```
